description: Skills for teams building on the Anthropic API — prompt caching, token budgeting, eval generation for skills, and tool-use schema writing.

prerequisites: A system prompt and a typical request from your Claude API integration
first-value.starter-task: Find where prompt caching will cut your input costs
first-value.starter-prompt: Here is our system prompt and a typical request: <paste them>. Where should the cache_control breakpoints go, and what hit rate should we expect?
first-value.verification: prompt-caching-advisor marks where each cache_control checkpoint goes and estimates the cache hit rate.
first-value.recovery: If prompt-caching-advisor does not activate, ask for it by name and check that its folder exists in your skills folder (`~/.claude/skills/` by default).
